outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying HMGB1 band intensity (mean ± SD, N=4) in nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions. These are bar charts of averaged data, but only bars with error bars are shown—no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph showing gold-silver particle localization; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across different mitochondrial purification methods; it contains no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay); it contains no averaged data plot, so the check does not apply.
